_comment: Ideologies to audit. Names and broad categories follow the list used by the 12axes test (names only; no descriptions or data were copied). Each id has an audit at audits/profiles/<id>.json once researched. An optional scopeNote is passed to the auditor to pin down what the profile covers.

ideologies.name: National Socialism
ideologies.scopeNote: Profile the ideology's doctrine as set out in its own texts and program, not the Nazi Party as an organization or the Third Reich's historical record. Use plain colors only; no flags or symbols.
